description: The plot illustrates the results of "Whisper fine-tunning, type = small," comparing four different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6 with a tick label interval of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale ranging from 25.0 to 42.5, with tick marks spaced every 2.5 units. All four lines are plotted in a brownish-gold color. The "small AdaLoRA_int4" configuration is represented by a solid line with circular markers, showing a steady decline from approximately 35.6 at epoch 0 to 30.5 at epoch 6. The "small AdaLoRA_int8" configuration is depicted by a solid line with square markers, which also steadily decreases from roughly 30.1 at epoch 0 to 25.1 at epoch 6. The "small int4" configuration is shown as a dashed line with circular markers; it begins at approximately 35.6 at epoch 0, rises to a peak of 42.1 at epoch 2, and then declines to 31.5 by epoch 6. Finally, the "small int8" configuration is illustrated with a dashed line and square markers, starting at roughly 30.1 at epoch 0, increasing to a peak of 33.7 at epoch 2, declining to a minimum of 25.4 at epoch 5, and ending slightly higher at 25.9 at epoch 6.
